description: This file defines a utility function 'auditLog' for logging audit-style entries to the console with ISO timestamp. It is intended for frontend use only and is used for traceability of user actions such as creating, reading, updating, deleting, or error events in the application.

methods.name: auditLog(actionType, event, details = {}, userId = DEFAULT_USER)
